skills.name: masthead-asset-prioritization
skills.description: Review monitoring tiers for BigQuery tables and BI assets against Masthead asset scores — propose PRIORITY or CRITICAL for assets that matter and REGULAR for prioritized assets that no longer do — explain each suggestion from the score metrics, and apply changes through the Masthead MCP server only on per-asset confirmation.
skills.description_zh: 依据Masthead资产评分评审BigQuery表与BI资产监控等级，解释优先、关键或常规建议，逐资产确认后才通过MCP应用。

skills.name: masthead-compute-savings-with-pipelines
skills.description: Optimize BigQuery compute costs by identifying and pausing/disabling unused, dead-end, or inefficient pipelines that consume compute resources.
headings: Step 1: Query Compute Waste from Pipelines
Step 4: Clean Up Target Tables (Storage Savings)
skills.name_hint: masthead · compute · savings · with · 管道
skills.description_zh: 识别并暂停或停用未使用、无下游用途或低效的流水线，以优化BigQuery计算成本。

skills.name: masthead-compute-savings-with-workload-assignments
skills.description: Optimize BigQuery compute costs by reassigning data models (Dataform, dbt, Airflow) or principals (service accounts, users) to slot reservations or on-demand compute based on Masthead recommendations without impacting performance.
headings: Decision Criteria: Reserved Slots vs. On-Demand
skills.name_hint: masthead · compute · savings · with · workload · assignments
skills.description_zh: 依据Masthead建议将Dataform、dbt、Airflow模型或服务账号用户重新分配至槽位预留或按需计算，以不影响性能为目标优化BigQuery计算成本。

skills.name: masthead-incident-triaging
skills.description: Triage, analyze downstream impact, and mitigate data quality and pipeline incidents using the Masthead MCP server.
skills.description_zh: 通过Masthead MCP分流数据质量与流水线事故，分析下游影响并实施缓解。

skills.name: masthead-savings
skills.description: Run the full Masthead FinOps audit across tables, datasets, pipelines, and data models. Same workflow as the Claude Code `/savings` command, invocable as `$masthead-savings` in Codex.
skills.description_zh: 对表、数据集、流水线和数据模型开展完整Masthead FinOps审计，与Claude Code的/savings流程相同，Codex可调用masthead-savings。

skills.name: masthead-storage-savings-with-datasets
skills.description: Optimize BigQuery storage costs at the dataset level by switching storage billing models and setting expiration policies.
headings: Generated for human operator review and execution:
Switch a dataset to physical billing
Switch a dataset back to logical billing (allowed only after 14-day lock-in period)
Check current billing model and expiration for a dataset
skills.description_zh: 在BigQuery数据集层面切换存储计费模式并设置过期策略，以优化存储成本。

skills.name: masthead-storage-savings-with-tables
skills.description: Optimize BigQuery storage costs by identifying and removing dead-end and unused tables.
headings: Optimize Storage Costs (Dead-end and Unused Tables)
skills.description_zh: 识别并移除无下游用途或未使用的BigQuery表，以优化存储成本。

skills.name: masthead-triage
skills.description: Triage active Masthead incidents with lineage and blast-radius analysis. Same workflow as the Claude Code `/triage` command, invocable as `$masthead-triage` in Codex.
skills.description_zh: 以血缘与影响范围分析分流活跃Masthead事故，与Claude Code的/triage流程相同，Codex可调用masthead-triage。
